Messages.Author: Mankrel
Messages.Body:
Simply Put, can i Throw my Kerrie with a Brute Force Strike?

And also, if i use Torn Signpost and have a Vampire with a Strength bonus in itself such as Tatu Sawosa, Hardestadt or maybe even an Enforcer do they add up or is the Strength set to 3 and cant go higher with Torn Signpost.

Thank you

Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
Yes, you can use a Kerrie at long range with:

Undead Strength,  Pushing the Limit , Brute Force, Lucky Blow, etc.

LSJ 10-06-2009
>
> You can because:
>
> -- Undead Strength is your strike.
> -- It allows you to make a melee weapon strike at +2 damage.
> -- Kerrie's long ranged strike option is a melee weapon strike.
>
Torn Signpost resets a minion's base strength from 1 to 2/3.
Any bonus applied to the minion is applied after that, so:

LSJ 10-16-2005
>
> The +X is added to the minion's strength, whatever it is.
>
Also  LSJ 08-13-2010 and  LSJ 03-02-2002

Although i don't know of any 4 Pool Melee weapon, theoretically, could i?

And also could the damage increase make it so i couldn't equip it anymore?

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Mankrel wrote:
> Thanks for clarifying for me, on a different note, Can i use Forger's Hammer with Concealed Weapon? or Forger's Hammer with Weighted Walking Stick.
>
No, card text.
Only usable when an action to equip a non-unique melee weapon from your hand is successful.

You haven't had a successful action to equip.

Additionally, action modifiers and reactions cannot be played in combat without explicit card text requiring it.

> Mankrel wrote:
> And if i can use Forger's Hammer with Concealed Weapon, does the price reduction make it so i can equip a Weapon with a cost of 4 Pool.

> Although i don't know of any 4 Pool Melee weapon, theoretically, could i?
